snippet.title: THYSIASTERY - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
THYSIASTERY IS OUT NOW!!!
The Labyrinth opens today. Your descent into the unknown awaits.

Heyyy everyone, the day has come!
THYSIASTERY, our debut title, is finally out.
So... You really want to go inside?

This launch marks the beginning of a new chapter for our studio and for everyone who has followed the journey so far.

THANK YOU!
Thank you for the support, the feedback, and the courage to step into something called a Labyrinth.
Bold choice, good luck!

Be sure to follow us on our social media channels and join our Discord server to get future updates and chat with us about your experience.
- DIRGA
